title: TextBitmapFont
description: Bitmap font file for toyph scrolling text animation. Each glyph is a binary pixel grid at the specified character height.

charHeight.description: Pixel height of character glyphs (topMargin + charHeight + bottomMargin must equal 13)

topMargin.description: Blank rows above the character area

bottomMargin.description: Blank rows below the character area

defaultSpacing.description: Columns of blank space between characters

glyphs.description: Map of character (as string) to glyph bitmap

pixels.description: Flat row-major pixel array. Length must equal charHeight * width. Values: 0 (off) or 4095 (max brightness).
